# Andi Muchlas Ramadani - Full-Stack & Geospatial Software Engineer Portfolio

A retro terminal-themed portfolio (AMRSYS 9400) showcasing engineering expertise across full-stack web platforms, geospatial routing engines, high-throughput backend services, and real-time interactive systems.

## Technical Skills
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Python, SQL, C#
- Frontend & Web: React, Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Leaflet, D3.js, WebSockets
- Backend & Geospatial: PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Spatial SQL, Uber H3 Hexagonal Grid, OSRM, Redis, NATS, Hono.js, gRPC (Protobuf), Scrapy ETL
- Real-Time & Interactive: Unity (C#), LiDAR Sensor Telemetry, WebSocket Streaming, Oculus LipSync
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (S3, IAM), Vercel, CI/CD, Linux
- Testing & Methods: Vitest (Automated Unit Testing), TDD, SEO (JSON-LD), REST & gRPC API Design
- AI & Automation: LLM Orchestration, Agentic Tool-Calling, n8n Workflow Automation, Webhook Integrations, DistilBERT
- Spoken Languages: Indonesian (Native), English (Professional Working Proficiency)

## Experience Summary
Full-Stack & Geospatial Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience delivering end-to-end applications. Proficient in crafting responsive, high-performance web frontends (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Three.js, Leaflet) backed by resilient distributed engines (Go, Node.js/Bun, PHP, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis, NATS, Kubernetes, gRPC Protobuf) and real-time interactive runtimes (Unity C#, LiDAR IoT sensors, WebSockets).

- Molca Teknologi Nusantara — Interactive Software Engineer
